interactiveObjects.name: Identity Document on Floor
interactiveObjects.description: A folded card bearing your photograph and the printed name Vermin Black.

transcript.speaker: Identity
transcript.text: You retrieve the document. The face staring back is unequivocally your own.

interactiveObjects.name: Silent 35mm Projector
interactiveObjects.description: A whirring projector mounted on a heavy metal tripod.

transcript.speaker: Projector
transcript.text: The shutter clicks at regular intervals, projecting empty white illumination upon the far wall.

interactiveObjects.name: Lacquered Music Box
interactiveObjects.description: A brass-filigreed music box resting in the corner where the ember cloud collapsed.

interactiveObjects.name: Reinforced Kitchen Cupboard
interactiveObjects.description: A locked metal storage cupboard built beneath the countertop.

interactiveObjects.name: Paneled Labyrinth Door
interactiveObjects.description: A heavy cedar door blending seamlessly with the wall paneling.

interactiveObjects.name: Iron Case File Cabinet
interactiveObjects.description: A locked four-drawer olive filing cabinet marked 'CONFIDENTIAL ADMISSIONS'.

interactiveObjects.name: Porcelain Clawfoot Bathtub
interactiveObjects.description: A white porcelain bathtub stained with dark crimson rings.

transcript.speaker: Memory
transcript.text: You look down into the empty tub. The memories of Bella and Braxton are clear and tidy.

interactiveObjects.name: Double Gilded Doors of the Verdict
interactiveObjects.description: Monumental double doors bound in cold alloy, barring the exit back to reality.

transcript.speaker: The Threshold
transcript.text: The key turns with the sound of a closing cell. The door opens back into the empty room where you first awoke.

interactiveObjects.name: First Gilded Mirror
interactiveObjects.description: A tall silvered mirror reflecting an empty white bathtub.

interactiveObjects.name: Second Gilded Mirror
interactiveObjects.description: A tall silvered mirror reflecting a clinic reception desk.

interactiveObjects.name: Third Gilded Mirror
interactiveObjects.description: A tall silvered mirror reflecting a closed door.

interactiveObjects.name: The Gilded Green Armchair
interactiveObjects.description: An armchair upholstered in green fabric with an ornate gold frame.

transcript.speaker: The Chair
transcript.text: The fabric is cool to the touch. It waits for the countdown to conclude.
